/obj/item/firing_pin.name: electronic firing pin
/obj/item/firing_pin.reason: The standard pin. Most guns already have one; you only need a spare for a gun without.

/obj/item/firing_pin/clown.name: hilarious firing pin
/obj/item/firing_pin/clown.reason: Makes the gun honk instead of firing, and can be forced into a gun lying around. A prank that costs bananium.

/obj/item/firing_pin/explorer.name: outback firing pin
/obj/item/firing_pin/explorer.reason: Refuses to fire on a ship, and every ship counts. Only useful for making a gun worthless at home.

/obj/item/firing_pin/implant/mindshield.name: mindshield firing pin
/obj/item/firing_pin/implant/mindshield.reason: Limits the gun to mindshielded users. A lock, not a weapon upgrade.

/obj/item/firing_pin/implant/pindicate.name: syndicate firing pin
/obj/item/firing_pin/implant/pindicate.reason: Limits the gun to users with a syndicate implant. A lock, not a weapon upgrade.

/obj/item/firing_pin/magic.name: magic crystal shard
/obj/item/firing_pin/magic.reason: Lets a wand fire. Every wand already comes with one.

/obj/item/firing_pin/paywall/luxury.name: paywall firing pin
/obj/item/firing_pin/paywall/luxury.reason: Charges the shooter per shot on a gun that was already fine. One pirate ship has it.

/obj/item/firing_pin/tag/blue.name: blue laser tag firing pin
/obj/item/firing_pin/tag/blue.reason: Laser tag pin. Only fires in a tag vest.

/obj/item/firing_pin/tag/red.name: red laser tag firing pin
/obj/item/firing_pin/tag/red.reason: Laser tag pin. Only fires in a tag vest.

/obj/item/firing_pin/test_range.name: test-range firing pin
/obj/item/firing_pin/test_range.reason: Fires only in a firing range. No use outside one.

/obj/item/gun_maintenance_supplies.name: gun maintenance kit
/obj/item/gun_maintenance_supplies.reason: Three uses of restoring a damaged gun and clearing jams and misfires. Worth having on long trips; most guns rarely need it.

/obj/item/gun_maintenance_supplies/makes.name: makeshift gun maintenance kit
/obj/item/gun_maintenance_supplies/makes.reason: One use of the same repair, crafted from pipe, cloth and iron.

/obj/item/handloaders_vise.name: handloader's vise
/obj/item/handloaders_vise.reason: Authored unique from armory caches. Packs spent casings of any caliber back into live rounds, one every 8 seconds, for a sheet of iron each.

/obj/item/suppressor.name: suppressor
/obj/item/suppressor.reason: Quiets a small gun. It changes who hears the fight, not who wins it, and it takes rep 22 to print.

/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/beam_rif.name: Event Horizon anti-existential beam rifle part kit (DOOMSDAY DEVICE, DO NOT CONSTRUCT)
/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/beam_rif.reason: Builds the Event Horizon, which deletes everything near the hit at 150 tiles. Six anomaly cores are the real gate.

/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/ebow.name: energy crossbow part kit (less lethal)
/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/ebow.reason: Turns a proto-kinetic accelerator and some radium into the energy crossbow: two bolts stun, and it never needs ammo.

/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/ion.name: ion carbine parts kit (nonlethal/highly destructive/very lethal (silicons))
/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/ion.reason: Turns a laser gun into the ion carbine. Decisive on borgs, suits and energy gear, nothing to a bare man.

/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/nuclear.name: advanced energy gun parts kit (lethal/nonlethal)
/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/nuclear.reason: Turns an energy gun into the advanced energy gun, which charges itself. A convenience, not more killing power.

/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/photon.name: photon cannon parts kit (nonlethal)
/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/photon.reason: Builds the photon cannon around one flux anomaly core: a flash that beats sunglasses, in a line and at its end.

/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/temperat.name: temperature gun parts kit (less lethal/very lethal (lizardpeople))
/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/temperat.reason: Turns a disabler into the temperature gun, which freezes or bakes on hit and slows hard. No damage.

/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/tesla.name: tesla cannon parts kit (lethal)
/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/tesla.reason: Builds the tesla cannon around one flux anomaly core: hitscan shocks worth about 135 a second, stopped by insulated gloves.

/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/xray.name: x-ray laser gun parts kit (lethal)
/obj/item/weaponcrafting/gunkit/xray.reason: Turns a laser gun into the X-ray gun, which shoots through walls and ignores armor.

/obj/item/weaponcrafting/receiver.name: modular receiver
/obj/item/weaponcrafting/receiver.reason: Goes into the pipegun and pipe pistol, both weak green guns. Crafts from a mousetrap, screwdriver and tape.

/obj/item/weaponcrafting/stock.name: rifle stock
/obj/item/weaponcrafting/stock.reason: Goes into the pipegun, laser musket and smoothbore disabler, all weak green guns. Crafts from wood and tape.

method: A kit rates as the gun it builds, using the gun ratings; the materials and anomaly core it needs are noted, not scored. Pins only restrict a gun, so they are none; other parts rate as what they make or how much they change a fight.
